reading.body:
This facility is listed as CTI Biopharma, a biopharmaceutical company headquarters, not a published data center operator. The address at 3101 Western Avenue in Seattle is confirmed via OpenStreetMap, but the classification as a data center was not independently verified. No power specifications, cooling capacity, or IT infrastructure details are published.

Washington State has 46 mapped facilities in this dataset, of which only 2 publish power consumption figures totaling 60 MW. This campus ranks third by published megawatts in the state, which means it either publishes capacity exceeding the two published facilities, or the ranking reflects incomplete data. The discrepancy between the number of mapped sites and those with published specs suggests most facilities in the state do not disclose their power footprint.

Without published specifications, this entry cannot be assessed for relevance to AI scaling. The biopharmaceutical designation and lack of disclosed power or infrastructure data indicate this may be a data classification error rather than an active hyperscale campus.
